outcome: control of Anaesthesia Induced Shivering (grade 2 or 3)
cohort: Sixty patients undergoing elective caesarian section under spinal anaesthesia who developed grade 2 or 3 shivering after induction.
finding: Tramadol effectively controlled anaesthesia-induced shivering in 86.66% of participants, which was comparable to pethidine (83.33%) with a significant p-value of 0.0001.
